row.body: tenant-ps-web proxied /health, /ps/briefs and /ps/criticality with a plain fetch to tenant-ps-core.ultrastable.workers.dev. Cloudflare refuses that inside one account. The front end now computes its own health and uses env.CORE for the rest.
